text: A new budget must be proposed by February 1 of each year.

text: A prize draw for people who fill in the budget survey closes February 26, 2027. Check EngageWR for when the survey itself closes.

text: If you rent, Ontario caps most rent increases at a yearly guideline (1.9% for 2027). A landlord can ask for more only if municipal taxes rise by an extraordinary amount. Units first lived in after November 15, 2018 have no cap.

citations.quote: The rent increase guideline for 2027 is 1.9%.
A landlord may apply to the Board for an order permitting the rent charged to be increased by more than the guideline
An extraordinary increase in the cost for municipal taxes and charges for the residential complex
that are occupied for the first time for residential purposes after November 15, 2018 are exempt from rent control

note: The agents said rent could rise as landlords pass on taxes; Ontario rent rules limit that, so it now says what the rules are.
